name: circular-text
title: Circular Text
description: Text set on a circle that turns slowly and speeds up or reverses under the pointer. The text is stretched to exactly one circumference (`textLength`), so it closes seamlessly whatever the font. Server-safe: rotation and hover are pure CSS, and screen readers get the text once.
